m: Salutation to Shri Ganesha. Thousands of faults are done by me day and night. Regarding me as your servant, forgive me, supreme sovereign.
I do not know the invocation, and I do not know the dismissal. I do not know the worship either. Forgive me, supreme sovereign.
Whatever I have offered, O Goddess, sovereign of the gods, lacking mantra, lacking rite, and lacking devotion, let that be complete for me.
A person who has done a hundred faults and then utters Mother of the world attains a state that even Brahma and the other gods do not reach.
I am at fault, and I have come to you for refuge, Mother of the world. I am now worthy of your compassion. Do as you wish.
Whatever was left undone or done in excess, through ignorance, forgetfulness, or confusion, forgive all of it, Goddess. Be gracious, supreme sovereign.
Sovereign of desire, Mother of the world, whose form is being, consciousness, and bliss, receive this worship with love. Be gracious, supreme sovereign.

You guard what is secret and what is most secret. Receive the recitation we have done. Let there be success for me, Goddess, by your grace, sovereign of the gods. Thus the prayer for the Goddess's forgiveness is complete.
